prerequisites: Competencies from Object-Oriented Programming, Algorithms and Data Structures, and Efficient Algorithms modules are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: develop efficient algorithms for computationally difficult graph problems
master the use of modern algorithm libraries
organize project work in a team, adequately document their work, and describe their developed algorithms and implementations in short presentations

syllabus_topics: fundamental techniques of algorithm engineering, especially for NP-hard problems
design, analysis, implementation and testing of algorithms
problem modeling and solution methods such as search tree algorithms, data reduction techniques and preprocessing
reduction to established solvers, problem formulation using propositional logic or integer linear programs

assessment_methods.method: presentation of 4 milestones in program development

assessment_rules: Grading is done with 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the M.Sc. Computer Science program.
bibliography: Stefan Schirra, Matthias Müller-Hannemann (eds). Algorithm Engineering. Springer, 2006.
